Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Experience working in Agile environments.

title: Sr SDET I
description:
We are looking for a Sr SDET 1 to improve the quality, reliability, and release confidence of products. You will work closely with software engineers, product managers, and other quality engineers to design test strategies, build maintainable automation, and make quality part of the development lifecycle. A key part of the role is validating features before they reach the QA environment, providing fast feedback while changes are still in the development process.
  
The role has a strong hands-on focus on browser automation using C#, Selenium WebDriver, and NUnit. You will contribute to our existing end-to-end test framework and CI pipelines and help ensure that critical workflows across the applications are covered by fast, trustworthy, and diagnosable tests.

  

Requirements:

* 3–5 years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation.
* Hands-on experience building browser automation with Selenium WebDriver and a test framework such as NUnit.
* Solid knowledge of object-oriented programming, automation testing, databases, networking, web services and UI applications
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD and build pipelines
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps or similar issue tracking tools
* Experience testing Angular/React applications.
* Experience with NUnit parallel execution, test sharding, and managing shared or environment-specific test data.
* Experience testing REST or GraphQL APIs alongside browser-based workflows.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and quality teams.
* Degree in computer science, information systems, or similar technical education preferred

Principal Accountabilities:
  

* Plan and perform pre-merge verification of feature changes before they are promoted to the QA environment, helping teams catch regressions early.
* Build and extend automated tests in C# using Selenium WebDriver and NUnit, following the framework's page-object and component-part patterns.
* Keep tests focused on one logical behavior, with clear setup, assertions, reporting, and cleanup.
* Use API clients for efficient test-data setup and cleanup where appropriate, while validating user-visible behavior through the UI.
* Make test runs safe to execute in parallel through isolated data, appropriate user and environment selection, and tracked resource cleanup.
* Identify coverage gaps, maintain test inventories or coverage documentation, and recommend the right level of testing for new and changed features.
* Review test code and pipeline changes, coach teammates, and promote pragmatic quality engineering practices across the team.
* Diagnose failures using test output, screenshots, browser logs, and CI artifacts; distinguish product defects from test, data, and environment issues.
* Partner with frontend and platform engineers to improve testability, including advocating for stable automation hooks when needed.

  

* Strong knowledge of C# or other object-oriented languages
* Strong knowledge or software architecture including SOLID, design patterns and design principles
* Knowledge of system architecture (such as microservices, containers, multi process applications and APIs
* Practical use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering activities, such as test design, code assistance, debugging, or summarizing test results, with the judgment to review and validate AI-generated output.
* Familiarity with mobile application testing or mobile automation frameworks is a plus.
* Experience in insurance, property restoration, construction, or remodeling software.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Job Description:

We are hiring a Senior SDET for Quality Assurance team. You will design and grow Playwright automation and the tooling around it, and you will use AI across the quality lifecycle: requirements analysis, test authoring, coverage review, debugging, and reporting. You will also own functional quality for your assigned applications. That includes manual and exploratory testing when human judgment is the better instrument. Automation and AI take the repeatable work so your manual effort goes where it adds the most value. You will work on applications that support ICE financial-markets infrastructure. A miss here is not cosmetic: defects can affect trading, clearing, data integrity, or regulatory evidence. We need someone who tests with that risk in mind. This is a hands-on Senior individual contributor role. You will influence design through code, reviews, and pairing. You will not manage people, and you will not be the sole owner of the organization-wide framework.

**Responsibilities**

* Test automation
  + Design, build, and maintain Playwright automation across UI, API, and integration layers.
  + Evolve the shared framework: page and component abstractions, fixtures, test data, environment configuration, CI/CD integration, and reporting.
  + Apply automation standards and design patterns that keep suites fast, reliable, and readable.
  + Reduce flakiness and improve execution speed through metrics and root-cause analysis.
  + Run automated suites in CI/CD and partner with DevOps on environments and pipeline reliability.
* AI-enabled quality workflow
  + Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to accelerate automation authoring, refactoring, debugging, and maintenance.
  + Use AI tooling to review requirements for ambiguities, missing edge cases, and untestable criteria before development begins.
  + Generate test cases from requirements, then refine, consolidate, and prioritize them with engineering judgment. You own the final suite, not the model.
  + Find coverage gaps, duplicate effort, and weak assertions in existing suites.
  + Adopt and extend AI tooling where it pays off. Building custom agent skills or MCP servers is a plus, not the core of the job.
* Functional test ownership
  + Own functional coverage and test strategy for assigned applications across UI, services, and integration points.
  + Decide what to automate and what to keep manual based on risk, stability, execution frequency, and maintenance cost. Expect a mix of automation and exploratory work, weighted toward automation once a flow is stable.
  + Perform manual, exploratory, and scenario-based testing where human judgment matters most.
  + Triage, reproduce, and document defects, and drive them to resolution.
  + Provide evidence-based release readiness to engineering and product leadership.
  + Produce clear reporting on coverage, execution results, defect trends, and release risk.
* Technical influence
  + Raise the quality of automation through code review and pairing with QA engineers.
  + Share practical patterns for automation, AI-assisted testing, and when manual testing is still the better approach.
  + Partner with software engineers, product managers, and DevOps to move quality work earlier in the delivery cycle.
* What you will work with
  + Playwright, TypeScript or JavaScript, Node, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
  + AI coding agents used as part of normal engineering work.
  + Jira and Xray (or equivalent) for defects, plans, and execution evidence.
  + API testing against REST and, where present, GraphQL.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* 7+ years in software quality engineering or SDET roles, including 5+ years of hands-on test automation.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright or a comparable modern E2E framework (Cypress, WebdriverIO, or similar), including suite structure, test data, and CI execution—not only recording or copying tests.
* Strong TypeScript or JavaScript and sound software engineering fundamentals: modular design, version control, code review, and refactoring.
* Applied experience using AI-assisted engineering tools in a routine workflow (coding agents, AI-assisted test authoring, or AI-supported requirements and code analysis).
* API test automation experience across REST or GraphQL.
* Experience contributing to a test automation framework and integrating automated tests into CI/CD.
* Strong functional testing foundation: test design techniques, risk-based prioritization, boundary and negative testing, and structured exploratory testing.
* Working knowledge of Jira, Xray, or equivalent defect and test management tools.
* Clear written and verbal communication. Test plans, defect reports, and quality summaries should be usable asynchronously.
* Ability to work on-site in Atlanta five days per week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep Playwright experience: framework architecture, flakiness mitigation, test data strategy, and execution at scale in CI.
* Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and AI tools.
* Experience creating AI agent skills, custom agents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
* Contract testing experience.
* Experience helping a QA team adopt automation and AI practices in a practical, sustainable way.
* Background in a regulated or high-reliability domain, ideally financial markets, trading, clearing, or market data.

title: Automation Engineer II
description:
Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

ICE Mortgage Technology (IMT) is the leading provider for the mortgage finance industry. ICE Mortgage Technology provides best-in-class servicing solutions to help manage all aspects of loan servicing - from loan boarding to default. Transform your performance with automation and insights and enhance customer experience. Our solutions support first mortgages as well as home equity loans, and help servicers lower costs, reduce risk and operate more efficiently. We're looking for motivated, result-oriented people to join our team.

We are looking for an individual to be service oriented, delivery focused and can build rapport with key members of the Operations and SRE teams specifying and implementing automation changes, fixes, and improvement projects. The ideal candidate will have excellent time and customer management skills, be able to work autonomously on projects combined with a range of technical skills and knowledge.

**Responsibilities**

* Building and maintaining tools and solutions for our operations platform, ensuring that we meet our customer service standards and reduce errors
* Actively troubleshoot any issues that arise during testing and production
* Update existing processes and design new processes as needed to optimize performance
* Work with the customers to understand their infrastructure automation solution requirements
* Understanding customer requirements and project KPIs
* Actively participate in or own continuous improvement projects driven by automation
* Any other activities as directed by management
* Work closely with the other team members to improve existing projects
* Create quality measurements to track improvement in projects
* Provide technical analysis, resolve problems, and propose solutions in a 24/7 production environment
* Participate in an on-call rotation

**Knowledge and Experience**

* 3+ years functional experience working as a DevOps Engineer
* Prior experience with software development, infrastructure development, or development and operations
* Strong experience with Microsoft Windows Server and Linux Administration
* Experience with scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell
* Experience in architecting an automation framework
* Proficiency in Configuration Management, CI, and automation tools such as – Rundeck, Jenkins, Chef, Puppet, Ansible or similar
* Experience with Agile methods (Scrum/Kanban) to organize project deliverables, to track and to report progress (Jira)
* Experience with git, git repo services (BitBucket, GitHub), and branching strategies
* Experience with monitoring and alerting tools (Splunk, Nagios, BigPanda, PagerDuty)
* Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Experience with automation of business continuity/disaster recovery
* Knowledge of and exposure to container technology (OpenShift) and orchestration is a plus
* Experience interacting with REST APIs (GET/POST requests), webhooks, and API client tools (Postman)
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Process-oriented with great documentation skills (Confluence)
* Experience with data structures/formats such as XML, JSON, YAML, and HCL

* Attend requirement gathering meetings with Product and Stakeholders to better understand business needs, functionality and system requirements
* Work in an Agile delivery methodology
* Provide regular and open communication across the program for transparency of progress and roadblocks
* Take ownership of test processes and implementing them

* Experience with version control systems like Git.

* Experience configuring, deploying and testing software updates
* Ability to identify issues and escalate as appropriate
* Ability to understand propagation of data through environments and components
* Familiarity working with APIs providing structured data
* Ability to communicate technical matters effectively to a variety of Stakeholders
* Familiarity working in an Agile environment and with Atlassian products, such as JIRA, confluence etc.
* Fluency and clarity in spoken and written English, being able to concisely communicate technical ideas internally and to UK/US staff
* Testing is conducted with 20% being manual and 80% automation.
